step.cmd: Fact-find with the employer to determine the client’s RFS.
Determine if the employer was reached during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the employer was reached, go to step 8.
If the employer was not reached or did not reply to the Z-00-00-00 letter, go to Reassigning the issue to Level 2 . Reassigning the issue to Level 2

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Reason for separation .
Comments: Type “Voluntary leaving — [employer’s name] — [last day worked] — employer.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
